text:
Type: bent plywood dining chair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, Japandi
Materials: molded birch veneer shell, solid birch legs, grey metal underframe
Colors: pale natural birch, light blond wood, grey
Shape: one-piece curved shell with a pinched waist and a rounded back, armless, four splayed round tapered legs, slim and light, compact
Feel: warm, calm, natural, airy
Goes with: light wood tables, white walls, linen and green plants; Scandinavian, Japandi or mid-century modern rooms
